  • Constructor Details

    • Style

      public Style(Color foreground, Color shadow, int shadowOffset, boolean outline, boolean clipToViewport)
      Create a style.
      Parameters:
      foreground - foreground color; if null, white is used
      shadow - shadow or outline color; null disables it
      shadowOffset - shadow/outline offset in pixels, normally 1 or 2
      outline - true for four-direction outline, false for one shadow
      clipToViewport - true to skip off-screen or behind-camera labels
